# Review comment template

[Up: Work templates](index.md)

Use this template for a review finding. Replace placeholders with the evidence and recommendation for the reviewed revision.

## 1. Comment body

**[Severity] — [Finding title]**

[Identify the precise location and show the evidence for the defect.]

[Explain the consequence and a useful correction. Distinguish a requirement from a preference and an observed result from uncertainty.]

## 2. Origin record

For Codex, finish the posted comment with the [handbook's review-comment origin block](../engineering/agent-operation.md#codex-review-comments), using the actual originating assignment. Remove template instructions before posting.
